mapper.sql: id, request_no AS requestNo, applicant_id AS applicantId, manager_id AS managerId, hr_id AS hrId, leader_id AS leaderId, leave_days AS leaveDays, leave_type AS leaveType, reason, approval_route AS approvalRoute, process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, status, final_decision AS finalDecision, final_comment AS finalComment, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flowable_leave_request ( request_no, applicant_id, manager_id, hr_id, leader_id, leave_days, leave_type, reason, approval_route, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requestNo}, #{applicantId}, #{managerId}, #{hrId}, #{leaderId}, #{leaveDays}, #{leaveType}, #{reason}, #{approvalRoute}, 'RUNNING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE flowable_leave_request SET process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND process_instance_id IS NULL

UPDATE flowable_leave_request SET manager_id = #{managerId}, hr_id = #{hrId}, leader_id = #{leaderId}, approval_route = #{approvalRoute}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE flowable_leave_request SET status = #{status}, final_decision = #{finalDecision}, final_comment = #{finalComment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
